Rashi on Yevamot 45a:10:1.hebrew: שפסלוה - כהנת מתרומת אביה; ולויה וישראלית, כגון שנישאו לכהן וילדו לו בנים, וכשמתו בעליהן היו אוכלות בתרומה בשביל בניהם. ואם בא עליה עובד כוכבים ועבד, פסלה מתרומה, וכ"ש מכהונה:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:10:1.english: That they render her unfit - [In the case of] a priest's daughter, [from] her father's terumah; and [in the case of] a Levite woman or an Israelite woman, [this applies] for example where they married a priest and bore him children, and when their husbands died they would eat terumah on account of their children. And if an idolater or a slave engaged in intercourse with her, he disqualified her from [eating] terumah, and all the more so from [marrying into] the priesthood.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:10:2.hebrew: מי שיש לו אלמנות וגירושין בה - כגון ישראלית הוא, דכי מת, "וזרע אין לה ושבה אל בית אביה" וגו' (ויקרא כ״ב:י״ג):
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:10:2.english: One who has widowhood and divorce with her - It is [only] in a case such as an Israelite that when [the husband] dies, "and she has no child, she shall return to her father's house," etc. (Leviticus 22:13).

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:10:3.english: Excluded are an idolater and a slave, who has no widowhood or divorce with her - For betrothal does not take effect [with them].

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:11:1.hebrew: א"ל אביי - לרב יוסף:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:11:1.english: Abaye said to him - To Rav Yosef.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:11:2.hebrew: מאי חזית דסמכת אדרב דימי - דאמר משמיה דרבי הולד ממזר, סמוך אדרבין דמכשרי ליה משמיה דרבי:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:11:2.english: What did you see that you rely upon Rav Dimi - who said in the name of Rabbi [that] the offspring is a mamzer? Rely upon Ravin, [for they] declare him fit in the name of Rabbi.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:12:1.english: For a certain [man] who came - [He was] the son of an idolater from a Jewish woman.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:14:1.hebrew: אמרי אנשי גמלא במדי אקבא רקדא - גמל גדול מרקד בתוך קב קטן בד' רגליו במלכות מדי. וגוזמא:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:14:1.english: People say: A camel in Media dances on a kav - A large camel dances inside a small kav on its four legs in the kingdom of Media. And [this is] an exaggeration.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:14:2.hebrew: הא קבא והא גמלא והא מדי - יבא וירקד לפנינו, כלומר: אתה שהתרת דבר חידוש, האמת דבריך ותן לו בתך:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:14:2.english: Here is the kav, and here is the camel, and here is Media - Let it come and dance before us! That is to say: you, who have permitted a novel [ruling], verify your words and give him your daughter.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:16:1.hebrew: לא הוה אזיל מקמיה - אותו בן העובד כוכבים דקא א"ל, הב לי ברתך:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:16:1.english: Would not go from before him - [meaning] that son of the idolater who was saying to him, "Give me your daughter."

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:17:1.hebrew: זיל איטמר - לך במקום שלא יכירוך, ושא בת ישראל, שאילו יכירוך לא יתנוה לך. אלמא לא ממזר הוא, מדאכשר ליה בת ישראל, שהרי ממזר מוזהר על הכשרה:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:17:1.english: Go, conceal yourself - Go to a place where they do not know you, and marry a Jewish woman, for if they knew you, they would not give her to you. Thus we see [that] he is not a mamzer, since he permitted a Jewish woman to him, for a mamzer is prohibited from [marrying] a fit [woman].

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:17:2.hebrew: בת מינך - בת ישראל מן העובד כוכבים, הכשרה כמותך, אבל ממזרת ושפחה לא תשא. אלמא כשר הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:17:2.english: A woman of your own kind - A daughter of a Jewish woman [and] an idolater, who is fit [to marry into the congregation] like you, but you may not marry a mamzeret or a slavewoman. Thus, [we see that] he is fit.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:17:3.hebrew: גלי - צא לגלות במקום שלא יכירוך, ויתנו לך בת ישראל כשרה:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:17:3.english: Go into exile - Go into exile to a place where they will not recognize you, and they will give you a fit Israelite woman [in marriage].

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:18:1.english: The residents of Bei Mikhsei - [Bei Mikhsei is] a place.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:19:1.english: Master of the teaching - [The one] who says [that when] an idolater or a slave cohabits with a Jewish woman, his son is fit.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:1:1.hebrew: חייבי לאוין דתפסי בהו קדושין - דנפקא לן בפרק כיצד (לעיל יבמות דף כג.) מ"כי תהיין לאיש שתי נשים וגו'". ועבד ועובד כוכבים לאו בני קדושין נינהו, דכתיב (בראשית כ׳:ג׳׳:ג׳״ב:ה׳) "שבו לכם פה עם החמור" — עם הדומה לחמור. ועובד כוכבים נמי ליתיה בכלל קדושין, דכתיב (דברים ז׳:ב׳-ג׳) בז' אומות "לא תתחתן בם" — לא יהא לך בהן חיתון. ובשאר אומות כתיב (שם כא) "ואח"כ תבא", מכלל דמעיקרא לית בה הויה. ומהני קראי נפקא לן בקדושין (דף סח:) דלא תפסי קדושין בעובדת כוכבים, ועובד כוכבים נמי מצי למילף מינייהו. הלכך, אין ביאתו ביאה לשם קדושין, ודמיא לחייבי כריתות. ובשאלתות דרב אחאי מפיק מהא: "והיא בעולת בעל" (בראשית כ), ודרשינן בסנהדרין (דף נז:): "בעולת בעל" יש להם, נכנסה לחופה ולא נבעלה אין להם, וכל שכן דארוסה לית להו; וביאה לשם קדושין נמי לית להו, דאיתקוש הויות להדדי:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:1:1.english: [Forbidden relations for which one is] liable for a prohibition, concerning which betrothal takes effect - For we derive [this] in Chapter Keitzad (above, Yevamot 23a) from "If a man have two wives, etc." And a [Canaanite] slave and an idolater [i.e., a gentile] are not subject to betrothal, as it is written (Genesis 22:5): "Stay here with the donkey" — a people (am) similar to a donkey (chamor). And an idolater is also not included in betrothal, as it is written (Deuteronomy 7:2–3) regarding the seven nations: "You shall not intermarry with them" — you shall have no marriage bond with them. And regarding the other nations it is written (Deuteronomy 21[:13]): "and afterward you may go in [unto her]" — which implies that initially there is no [valid] marriage (havayah) with her. And from these verses we derive in Kiddushin (68b) that betrothal does not take effect with a gentile woman; and [the case of] a gentile man can also be derived from them. Therefore, his intercourse is not intercourse for the sake of betrothal, and it is comparable to [relations] liable to karet. And in the She'iltot of Rav Achai, he derives [this] from this [verse]: "for she is a man's wife (be'ulat ba'al)" (Genesis 20[:3]), and we expound in Sanhedrin (57b): "a man's wife (be'ulat ba'al)" — they have [a recognized status of marriage through consummation]; [one who] entered the bridal canopy and did not have intercourse — they do not have [it], and all the more so they do not have [the status of] a betrothed woman (arusah); and they also do not have intercourse for the sake of betrothal, since [all modes of] marriage (havayot) are compared to one another.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:2:1.hebrew: אין ממזר וכו' - והא האי תנא כשמעון התימני סבירא ליה, וקתני בעובד כוכבים ועבד דאין ממזר:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:2:1.english: There is no mamzer, etc. - Now, this Tanna holds like Shimon HaTimni, and teaches regarding an idolater and a slave that [the offspring] is not a mamzer.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:3:1.hebrew: אף על גב דקאמר רבי - בפרק ר"ג: אין ביאה אחר חליצה, דאם חלץ לזו ובעל את זו, אינה צריכה הימנו גט. וקאמר: אין הדברים הללו אמורים — דביאה אחר חליצה לא תפסה — אלא לדברי ר"ע כו', אבל לדידיה לא סבירא ליה. אפילו הכי, בעובד כוכבים ועבד מודים:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:3:1.english: Although Rabbi says - In the chapter [entitled] Rabban Gamliel [it is taught]: There is no [valid] intercourse after chalitzah — for if he performed chalitzah with this [woman] and cohabited with that [woman], she does not require a bill of divorce from him. And [Rabbi] says: "This statement" — that intercourse after chalitzah does not take effect — "was said only according to the view of R. Akiva," etc., but he himself does not hold [so]. Even so, regarding an idolater and a slave, they agree.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:3:2.english: As, when Rav Dimi came, etc., in the name of our Master - Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi].

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:6:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רב יוסף רבי היא - לא תחשוב גברי, דהאי משום רבותא דרבים לא תפסיל ליה, דהא נמי רבים אכשרי. אלא משום ההיא דר' איכא למיפסליה, דהלכה כמותו:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:6:1.english: Rather, Rav Yosef said: It is Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi's opinion] - Do not count men, for you cannot disqualify this [offspring] on account of the majority of [Sages], since here too many [Sages] declared [him] fit. Rather, it is on account of that [ruling] of Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] that one must disqualify him, for the halakha is in accordance with him.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:7:1.english: And didn't Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi say - above, [that] the offspring is fit?

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:8:1.hebrew: זו שאיסורה שוה בכל - עובד כוכבים אסור בין בכהנת, בין בלויה, בין בישראלית:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:8:1.english: This [woman] whose prohibition is equal for all - A gentile is forbidden whether with a kohen's daughter, whether with a Levite woman, [or] whether with an Israelite woman.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:8:2.hebrew: שבנה פגום - בנה פגום לאו דוקא, דהא פשיטא בן העובדת כוכבים לאו כהן הוא; ואי משום דלא ישא כהנת — כיון דמותר בישראלית, מותר נמי בכהנת, שאין קדושה בנשים, דאפילו כשרות מותרות לפסולים, דקיימא לן (קדושין דף עג.) לא הוזהרו כשרות מלינשא לפסולים. אלא משום בתה נקט, דאם תלד בת, פסולה לכהונה:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:8:2.english: That her child is flawed - "Her son is flawed" is not [meant] literally, for it is obvious [that] the son of a gentile is not a priest; and if [it means] that he may not marry a daughter of a priest, since he is permitted to [marry] an Israelite woman, he is also permitted to [marry] a daughter of a priest, for there is no [priestly] sanctity [regarding marriage restrictions] in women, as even women of unblemished lineage are permitted to [marry] disqualified men, for we hold (Kiddushin 73a) [that] women of unblemished lineage were not warned against marrying disqualified men. Rather, [the Gemara] stated [this] on account of her daughter, for if she gives birth to a daughter, she is disqualified from [marrying into] the priesthood.

Rashi on Yevamot 45a:9:1.hebrew: פסלה - אפי' מתרומה דבי נשא, וכ"ש מלהנשא לכהן:
Rashi on Yevamot 45a:9:1.english: He renders her unfit - Even from [eating] terumah of her father's house, and all the more so from marrying a priest.

Tosafot on Yevamot 45a:10:1.hebrew: יצאו עובד כוכבים ועבד שאין לו אלמנות וגירושין בה - וא"ת: והא רבי יוחנן אית ליה לעיל דעובד כוכבים ועבד הבא על בת ישראל הולד ממזר, אם כן למה לי קרא? דהשתא ממזר הוי, מפסיל בביאתו מיבעיא?! וי"ל: הא דידיה והא דרביה. ועוד, דאמוראי נינהו ואליבא דרבי יוחנן, כדאמרינן ספ"ק (לעיל יבמות טז:), ושם פירשתי אמאי הוי ממזר מעובד כוכבים כיון דביאת היתר היא מדאורייתא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 45a:10:1.english: Excluded [is] an idolater or a slave, who has no [application of] widowhood or divorce with her - And if you ask: Behold, Rabbi Yoḥanan holds above that [when] an idolater or a slave engages in intercourse with a daughter of Israel, the child is a mamzer; if so, why do I need a verse [to teach this]? For now [that] he [causes the child to] be a mamzer, is it necessary [to state] that he disqualifies [her] through his intercourse?! And one can answer: This [statement] is his own [opinion], and that [statement] is his teacher's [opinion]. And furthermore, [they are differing] Amora'im according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, as we say at the end of the first chapter (above, Yevamot 16b); and there I explained why [the child] is a mamzer from an idolater, since it is permitted intercourse according to Torah law.

Tosafot on Yevamot 45a:17:1.hebrew: זיל איטמר - וישיאוך מיוחסת. וא"ת: והא בעי ראיה, כדאמר בפ"ב בכתובות (דף כד: ושם), דמעלין מתרומה ליוחסין? ויש לומר: דהתם להשיא בתו לכהן העובד על גבי המזבח, כמו שמוכיח שם רבינו תם. א"נ: התם כר"מ, אבל חכמים אומרי': "כל משפחות בחזקת כשרות הם עומדות", בפרק עשרה יוחסין (קדושין דף עב:):
Tosafot on Yevamot 45a:17:1.english: Go conceal [yourself] - And they will marry you to a woman of [unblemished] lineage. And if you ask: But does [this] not require proof, as it says in the second chapter of Ketubot (24b and there), that one elevates [a person] from terumah to [unblemished] lineage? And one can answer: There [it refers] to marrying one's daughter to a priest who serves upon the altar, as Rabbeinu Tam proves there. Alternatively: There [it is] in accordance with Rabbi Meir, whereas the Sages say: "All families stand in a presumption of fitness," in the chapter [entitled] Asarah Yuchasin (Kiddushin 72b).
